assets.purpose: Village welcome, chapter landscape and table listing
assets.prompt: Create a production game landscape illustration for DropInn, a fantasy tabletop game lovingly drawn by kids using an old MS Paint mouse tool. WIDE LANDSCAPE 1536x1024. Subject: the welcoming crooked little village inn of Briar Glen, big butter-yellow windows, lopsided coral-red roof, leaf-green round trees, funny uneven fence and winding sandy footpath, tiny lavender mountains and a pale blue dusk sky with a wonky crescent moon. Broad simple shapes, very chunky near-black uneven slightly jagged outlines, childlike awkward perspective, cheerful flat marker fill colors, minimal shading. Match the spirit of the DropInn sheep reference: amateur, expressive, lovingly imperfect, bold silhouette; NOT polished vector art, not painterly textured watercolor, not glossy, not photorealistic, no intricate details. Palette warm cream, coral, golden yellow, sky blue, lavender, leaf green, ink. The inn is the main subject in the center-right; keep left third quieter open sky and green hill for separate HTML copy. Keep important subjects in the central 65% so wide banner and square thumbnail crops work. Full-bleed opaque landscape, no text, no letters, no logo, no UI, no watermark. No faces on the building. Friendly all-ages adventure, charming handmade board-game illustration.

Create one isolated transparent PNG cutout for DropInn, a fantasy tabletop game lovingly drawn by kids in old MS Paint. SQUARE 1024x1024, genuine alpha transparency, no background or checkerboard. Subject GLOAMFANG: a goofy corrupted guardian, a squat coiled lavender-purple dragon-wolf creature, huge uneven fluffy head, mismatched round yellow eyes, one bent ear and one crooked small horn, two silly cream fangs, oversized front paws, curled tail, three simple dark violet shadow wisps, a broken golden ward charm at its neck. It is trying very hard to look scary but is endearingly awkward. Clear readable whole silhouette centered with at least 10% transparent margin, no cropped paws or tail. Color palette lavender, deep purple, golden yellow, cream, coral nose. Small simple forms must read at 72px. Not polished vector, not 3D, not photorealistic, not watercolor, no detailed fur, no horror or gore, no text, no UI, no logo. One creature only. Complete opaque colored creature with transparent space outside.
